verdict.rationale: Rollbar is a SaaS error-monitoring service that ships AI features such as the Resolve agent, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documented control or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Customizable data retention and token scoping are adjacent privacy controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
